description: Customer support agent handling a billing issue over 10 turns

turns.content: Hi, I need help with my account. My account number is AC-29481 and I'm on the Premium plan. I was charged $149 instead of the usual $99.
I can see your account AC-29481 on the Premium plan. The extra charge of $50 appears to be from an overage fee for exceeding the 500GB storage limit. You currently have 623GB stored.
I was never notified about any storage limit. When did this start?

The 500GB storage limit has been part of the Premium plan since January 2026. A notification email was sent on February 15th when you crossed the threshold. The overage rate is $0.10 per GB over the limit.
I definitely did not receive that email. This is frustrating. Can you reverse the charge?

I understand your frustration. I can offer a one-time courtesy credit of $50 for this billing cycle. Going forward, you have two options: upgrade to the Enterprise plan at $149 which includes 1TB storage, or reduce your storage below 500GB.
The Enterprise plan sounds reasonable. What other features does it include compared to Premium?

Enterprise includes 1TB storage, priority support with 2-hour response time, advanced analytics dashboard, and API rate limits of 10,000 requests per minute versus 1,000 on Premium. The upgrade takes effect immediately with prorated billing.
Let's go with the Enterprise upgrade. And please apply that courtesy credit.

Done. Your account AC-29481 has been upgraded to Enterprise. The $50 courtesy credit has been applied to your current invoice. Your next billing date is April 1st at $149 per month. Is there anything else I can help with?
